desc:
✈️⛽ Welcome to Fuel Your Plane! ⛽✈️

⛽ Collect Fuel!
Gather fuel around your base and prepare your planes for takeoff.

✈️ Fly & Earn Money!
Take off, burn fuel, and earn cash while flying.

🛠️ Unlock Better Planes & Upgrades!
Get faster planes, bigger fuel tanks, and powerful upgrades to boost your progress.

🏗️ Upgrade Your Base!
Improve fuel production, unlock new features, and expand your base.

🌍 Fly Further & Earn More!
The farther you fly, the more you earn.

🏆 Compete With Other Players!
Climb the leaderboard and prove you have the strongest fleet.

❗ Fuel Generates Even While You're Offline! ❗
